**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

Once per scene, when a failed attack with your Conduit Weapon would trigger a printed backlash, overdraw, dropped-weapon consequence, or Conduit Strain increase, reduce one numerical consequence by one step:

- reduce damage by one damage die;
- reduce forced movement by 5 feet;
- reduce Strain, Crack, Corruption, or a similar counted state by 1; or
- prevent the weapon from being dropped.

If the complication has none of those components, this Insight cannot reduce it.
